idea-plugin.name: Spectra Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Browse Spectra changes without leaving the IDE.
Spectra moves parked changes out of openspec/changes/ and into the git directory, where the project tree never shows them. This plugin adds a Spectra tool window that lists active, parked and archived changes side by side, shows task progress for each one, and opens their Markdown artifacts in the editor. It reads the files directly, so the spectra CLI does not need to be installed.
